modelling_choices: Cyclic balanced target encounters; independent Bernoulli contexts and observed payment. Exact temporal reader integrates RAGE. BP has separate conditional-RAGE and act factors, damping 0.5, tolerance 1e-12, 200 iterations. Circular messages have exponent two. Extended Kalman cue learner starts at zero with identity covariance and maps target weight using logit(0.3)+4w. Scores use final dislikes.
